channel.description: Recent content in Ethics on Pivtorak.Studio

item.title: 010 Coordinates of the Heart. Vector Navigation and the Ethics of Inner Honesty
item.description: The heart answers ‘Where?’. The mind answers ‘How?’. Core Recalibration begins when absence of energy is recognized as a system signal rather than a personal failure.

item.title: 04-01 Vulnerability Point. Human Factor
item.description: This work diagnoses the fragility of authoritarian regimes through the conscience of their executors. Even the most disciplined apparatus cannot fully suppress humanity. A single moment of doubt may become the beginning of systemic collapse.

item.title: 07-05 Revival of Identity. Ethics as a Foundation. Zoroastrianism as Ethics
item.description: A civilizational reconstruction where ethics transforms from external control into internal hygiene, aligning thought, speech, and action.

item.title: ✯ Extra Credit Problem (The Asterisk Problem)
item.description: A multidisciplinary research framework examining countries and regions where freedom, human dignity, child protection, and individual agency face systemic challenges. Each case study maps the path from tragedy and diagnosis to recovery, subjectivity, and civilizational renewal.
